text:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a burst of Xid 13 and ECC corrected errors across three eu-west-1 GPU nodes, looks correlated with a nightly training sweep. Draining the nodes now.

mira: Thanks, Alex. Which hosts? Can you paste the serials so I can open the vendor ticket?

alex: hosts: gpu-eu-042, gpu-eu-043, gpu-eu-055
serials: GFXSN-9Z1A2, GFXSN-9Z1A3, GFXSN-9Z1B7
Drain cmds run: `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-042 && kubectl drain gpu-eu-042 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

sam: Noted. Do we classify as flaky or hard-fail? Xid 13 with ECC corrected could be on the fence. Any persistent ECC uncorrected?

alex: So far only corrected ECC and repeated Xid 13 entries. Sample journal excerpt:```
Mar 04 03:12:01 gpu-eu-042 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, pid=3184, ...
Mar 04 03:12:01 gpu-eu-042 kernel: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus. Recovered with reset.
```

jordan: If they come back after reset repeatedly, we treat as flaky > RMA. How long were they up between resets?

alex: avg uptime between resets ~ 2 hours during the job window. Repro rate ~ 4-6 per night.

mira: Given nightly job exposure and frequency, vendor will want reprod logs + serials. I'll open tickets but ask Logistics for depot swaps due to EU region constraints. @tara — can you confirm depot options for Ireland vs Netherlands? Shipping SLA impact? :truck: 

tara: Ireland depot can do next-business-day for swapped cards if courier accepts RMA manifests before 17:00 UTC. NL depot has same-day depots but higher customs hold risk for certain vendors. For these serials, NL preferred if we can get vendor paperwork pre-cleared.

eng-oncall-bot: Automated note: affected nodes have been cordoned and pods drained. Eviction summary: 46 pods rescheduled. No user-facing incidents.

sam: Also flag cost: if we schedule urgent courier instead of depot swap there is a ~€450 expedite fee per card. Check budget on ad-hoc RMAs.

mira: I'll open vendor tickets with reproducible steps + attach dmesg + nvidia-smi logs. Template: `problem: repeated Xid 13 + ECC corrected resets during sustained high-util job; repro rate 4-6/night; serials: ...; logs: attached`

alex: Putting sample `nvidia-smi -q` and temperatures in the ticket:
```
GPU 0: Temp 86 C, Perf P2, Util 99%
ECC errors (corrected): 1245
```

jordan: 86C is high but within throttle range; could be thermal contributing. Are fans at expected RPM?

alex: fans at 85%, ambient in rack ~29C. We saw similar pattern on a past unit that vendor acknowledged thermal susceptibility and replaced under RMA.

tara: Logistics note: if vendor requires depot swap, we need an RMA manifest with serials + customer PO reference. I can generate manifest once Mira posts ticket number. We should mark units as 'do not redeploy' in inventory to avoid accidental pickup.

mira: Ticket opened: VEND-81234. I'll paste link in thread and upload logs.

mira: Link: https://vendor.portal/rma/VEND-81234 (internal)

sam: For interim capacity: can we drain 3 more lower-risk nodes to compensate auto-scale? Cost/throughput impact minimal tonight but keep an eye on queued jobs.

alex: Created a short-term policy: auto-scale up 3 GPUs in us-west if queue > 30 for >10m. Will monitor.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window in eu-west-1 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. This aligns with the observed job. Consider rescheduling heavy training.

jordan: Long-term ask: can infra add an 'ECC delta' alert (rate of corrected ECCs per GPU/min) so we detect ramps earlier? Current Xid alerts are noisy.

alex: +1 for ECC delta metric. For now, I'll attach a CloudWatch metric query that aggregates corrected ECCs per minute and set a 5-min anomaly alert.

mira: After vendor triage, if they accept thermal explanation, we can request replacement heatsink/fan assembly instead of full card swap — faster depot processing. Will note in ticket.

tara: I'll provision an RMA manifest and tentative courier booking for NL depot pending vendor approval. ETA manifest tomorrow morning.

alex: Thanks team — I'll keep thread updated with any fresh Xid spikes. If vendor asks for cards back, we'll follow NL depot flow. :white_check_mark:
